abilities.description:
Your superiors trust you with a special mission. Roll on Oracles to reveal the redacted info below. For the Callsign, create a character. They begin as a powerful ally, you gain +2 when they assist you with their specialty, and take +2 momentum on a hit. The Planet becomes a vital system, with lots of allies to your faction, so add +1 when you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.13b2d777c6fb719d]{Gather Information} there. This is an important mission, you take your normal adds for it, and you mark it as formidable difficulty. For the Focus below, @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-1) when interacting with its element. If you complete the mission, reflect on all you’ve learned, and raise any stat by 1.

You are to report to CODENAME [CALLSIGN] on [PLANET] and immediately commence OPERATION [DESCRIPTOR & THEME] to [MISSION ORACLE] by the name of [NAME]. Beware of the [FOCUS], or else all may be lost.
